jobs.title: Software Designer (C#, C++, Java)
jobs.description:
As a Software Designer C#/C++/JAVA, you develop software for high-tech products and machines.

In this role, you support our customers in the semiconductor, analytical instrumentation, and medical equipment industries, within the triangle of Nijmegen, Enschede, and Zwolle, by delivering smart, sustainable, and reliable software solutions. Your software expertise plays an essential role in bringing these high-tech solutions to life.

What excites you as a Software Designer (C#, C++, Java)?

As a Software Designer, you contribute to defining requirements and you are responsible for translating them into robust software designs, ensuring high-quality implementation and seamless integration. You are eager to grow into a role where you bring your own technical contribution, while guiding the development team.

From our office in Mijdrecht and at our clients' premises you work on challenging projects that take technology to the next level. You are the expert who designs, develops, and tests, but also likes to think along, connect, and contribute to team results, and who likes to:

Translating customer and system requirements into innovative, clear, and feasible concepts during the conceptual phase of projects.
Acting as a bridge between architects and engineers from a technical perspective.
Taking responsibility for a module/subsystem throughout the entire software development lifecycle.
Ensuring software quality, scalability and maintainability through sound engineering practices.
Applying strong communication skills to effectively guide and mentor a team of engineers, helping them grow and deliver high-quality results.

Sounds good? We’d love to tell you more…

Your future workplace

This is what you bring to the table

You have a technical Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Computer Engineering.
You have 7+ years of experience in technical software development, gained in various roles and across diverse product environments and/or projects.
Over the past 4–5 years, you have worked within technical domains such as Semicon, Medical, or Analytical.
You have experience with at least two of the following programming languages: C#, C++, or Java.
You have knowledge of and/or experience with various development methodologies and techniques such as Design Patterns, UML, and Agile, and you keep your technical expertise up to date. You are looking for an environment where you can apply these developments in practice as well.
Based on your experience, you are able to coach junior engineers.
You are a team player and keep the common goal in mind.
You have a good command of both Dutch and English, spoken and written.
You hold a valid European driver’s license and are willing to travel.

This is what you can expect in return from Sioux

Flexible 32-40 hour working week, with room to work from home.
A healthy work-life balance is very important to us. We have 28 holidays with an option to acquire an additional 12 holidays.
You will work with passionate colleagues who share your drive for technology and business success.
By combining our expertise in software, electronics, mechanics, mechatronics, mathematics and assembly, we make the impossible possible for our customers and get to work on challenging high-tech projects.
You get a lot of freedom and responsibility; after all, you know exactly what you are doing.
Personal coaching and a training budget of €6000 per year, so that you can continue to develop yourself.
We also find it important to have fun together. We organize a lot for our employees, from events together with your partner and family, summer barbecues, innovative knowledge sessions to tasty lunches and after work drinks.
You will be working at a prime location in a green, wooded environment, close to the Veluwe National Park. The perfect base within the triangle of Enschede, Zwolle, and Nijmegen.

High Tech & High Fun

We can tell you all about the typical Sioux-culture and the high-tech challenging projects. About how you can develop yourself, like nowhere else. But we’d rather have you hear it from our own employees.

If you want to know more about our challenging projects, please click here.

jobs.title: test automation engineer forensische opsporing
jobs.description:
Binnen de afdeling Forensische Opsporing ontwikkelen we een applicatie waarbij de forensisch onderzoeker de sporen kan vastleggen bij bijv. een woninginbraak, plofkraak of moord. Wil jij als Test Automation Engineer een belangrijke en nuttige bijdrage leveren? Maak dan je CSI-droom waar bij ons!

Wat ga je doen?

Je gaat aan de slag in één van de drie ontwikkelteams binnen het Programma Vernieuwend Registreren - Cluster Forensische Opsporing (FO). In dit team word jij dé tester en werk je nauw samen met de ontwikkelaars en informatieanalist uit je eigen team. Daarnaast zoek je de samenwerking op met de test automation engineers van andere ontwikkelteams, zowel binnen als buiten FO.

Jouw rol is het verder uitbreiden en professionaliseren van testautomatisering waarbij we gebruik maken van TestCafé (in de nabije toekomst Playwright) voor de front-end integratie- en end-to-end-testen.

Verder ga je aan de slag met

Uitvoeren en reviewen van functionele (handmatige en geautomatiseerde) testen;
Uitvoeren en ondersteunen van keten- en gebruikersacceptatietesten;
Opzetten, uitbreiden en onderhouden van testautomatisering;
Bijdragen aan de innovatie van testautomatisering en verbeteringen bepalen en doorvoeren;
Opstellen en vastleggen van testscenario’s en testcases;
Actief aandragen van structurele verbetervoorstellen;
Actief bijdragen aan refinements, Three Amigos sessies en de Community of Practice Test;
Actief kennis delen binnen en buiten je team over teststrategieën en testautomatisering;
Vraagbaak voor collega’s binnen het team;
Samenwerking met ontwikkelaars in het testproces;
Afhankelijk van de workload waar nodig ook ontwikkel- en/of beheerwerkzaamheden oppakken;
Representeren van het team en het testwerk naar buiten toe, zoals presenteren aan stakeholders.

Waar ga je werken?

Je gaat aan de slag binnen het Productiehuis waar we cruciale softwareoplossingen ontwikkelen en onderhouden die het politiewerk dagelijks ondersteunen. Je maakt deel uit van de Productielijn Handhaving, Cluster Forensische Opsporing waar je in een multidisciplinair team werkt aan het ontwikkelen van nieuwe functionaliteiten voor operationele politiediensten.

We werken Agile en hybride, dat betekent dat je twee dagen per week fysiek op locatie in Utrecht te vinden bent en daarnaast thuis kunt werken. De overall sfeer in de FO-teams is open, informeel en we delen onze passie voor het vakgebied.

Je komt te werken in een bevlogen team en daar zoeken wij een enthousiaste collega bij. Iemand die graag investeert in het leren kennen van zijn/haar collega’s, positieve energie meebrengt en trots is op zijn/haar werk voor de Forensische Opsporing bij de politie.

Daarnaast voel jij je niet alleen verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit van je eigen testwerk, maar draag je ook actief bij aan de kwaliteit van testen en de testprocessen binnen de Forensische Opsporing.

Wie ben jij?

Wij zoeken eigenlijk gewoon een hele leuke en ervaren tester
in ons nieuw op te bouwen team. Ben jij dat en heb je verder

hbo (bachelor) werk- en denkniveau en een opleiding bij voorkeur in de richting van ICT of soortgelijk;*
minimaal een certificaat van ISTQB, TMAP of CAT;
aantoonbare ervaring met gestandaardiseerde testtools, zoals TestCafé, Cypress en/of Playwright;
minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring met geautomatiseerd testen en handmatig testen;
bij voorkeur ervaring met Agile werken.

In verband met het begrijpen van, en navigeren door, het werk van de ontwikkelaars en testers, is het ook een pre als je iets van ervaring hebt met

Java en/of TypeScript
Git
Jenkins
Angular

Wat wij bieden

De formele standplaats is Utrecht. Er is ruimte voor 1 fte. Het betreft een functie voor 36 uur per week (36 uur is standaard een fulltime werkweek bij de politie).

Omdat goede mensen belangrijk zijn binnen de politie investeren we in jouw toekomst. We bieden uitgebreide ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en een aanstelling in tijdelijke dienst voor een proeftijd van een jaar. Bij voldoende functioneren zetten we na een jaar de aanstelling o m in een vaste aanstelling.

Verder kun je van ons verwachten

een bruto maandsalaris van minimaal € 3.734,- en maximaal € 5.882,- (schaal 10 Bbp) op basis van een 36-urige werkweek;
een Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB) dat uit twee delen bestaat

jobs.description:
Wil jij jouw skills en ervaring graag maatschappelijk inzetten? Ben jij een developer die geen uitdaging uit de weg gaat? Solliciteer dan nu!

Wat ga je doen?

Jij vertaalt de userstory’s en bedenkt samen met je team oplossingen en manieren om een toegewezen applicatie op technisch en op functioneel gebied te verbeteren. Dit doe je samen met je collega’s in een multidisciplinair scrumteam. Als lid van een multidisciplinair team ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor

Front- en/of backend ontwerpen, beheren en door ontwikkelen van onze registratieve systemen;
Het ontwikkelen en aanbrengen van wijzigingen in de database;
Het (door)ontwikkelen van het Continuous Integration en het Continuous Delivery proces (o.a. Jenkins);
In sprints waarde voor de business ontwikkelen en opleveren;
Meedraaien in piketrooster voor beheer en implementatie.

Meer over DevOps bij de politie.

Waar ga je werken?

Binnen het productiehuis bouwen en onderhouden zo’n honderd DevOps-teams de informatiesystemen voor de Nederlandse politie. Jij gaat werken binnen de Hanze Express van Productielijn Handhaving.

Binnen de productielijn staat het delen van kennis en ervaring centraal. Onze hoofdtaak is het bouwen, onderhouden en beheren van een webapplicatie en de daaronder liggende middleware en ondersteunende systemen (API’s). We werken volgens de Agile-methodiek met prioritering vanaf de product backlog. De teams combineren het thuiswerken deels met werken op het politiedienstencentrum te Zwolle. Onze teams werken onder andere aan

De Basis Voorziening Handhaving (BVH) is de applicatie die door de basispolitiezorg wordt gebruikt om proces-verbaal op te maken van incidenten, aanhoudingen, verhoren, verkeersongevallen, inbeslaggenomen goederen en dergelijke.
De Generieke Gegevens Koppeling (GGK) is een platform dat de uitwisseling van gegevens uit de verschillende BVH's binnen de politie efficiënt en veilig mogelijk maakt door gebruik te maken van RESTful API’s en Event Driven Architecture-oplossingen, met een focus op standaardisatie van gegevens en interoperabiliteit tussen systemen.
De Handhaving Ontsluiting Service (HOS) ontsluit gegevens uit registratieve systemen binnen de BVH naar andere diensten binnen de politie.

Om meer inzicht te krijgen hoe onze systemen bijdragen aan de politietaak stimuleren we onze medewerkers om dit zelf te ervaren door een dienst mee te gaan met een collega in het veld.

Jij kunt binnen een complexe omgeving slimme IT-aanpassingen te bedenken en realiseren. Feedback geven en krijgen gaat je goed af en je maakt je nieuwe kennis snel eigen. Je bent gericht op samenwerken en neemt het voortouw om het team met elkaar te laten afstemmen. Je gaat uitdagingen niet uit de weg en je denkt graag mee aan vernieuwende oplossingen. Je hebt de kennis en ook ruime ervaring om de continuïteit en kwaliteit van softwareontwikkeling te kunnen borgen. Je bent je bewust van je vaardigheden en werkt actief aan het vergroten van je expertise. Verder heb je

Ervaring met unittesten en bij voorkeur met testautomatisering (wij gebruiken Selenium en Cucumber) en de beveiligingsaspecten van software.

Kennis van systemen zoalsOpenShift (Podman, Docker) en Weblogic.

Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift.

jobs.title: AI Platform engineer
jobs.description:
Your job

Within WUR, we are setting up our own chatAI environment in which our users (students, teachers, researchers) can use the possibilities of Artificial Intelligence for research and education safely and within established guardrails. This includes the WUR AI Chat, the WUR LLM Hub and integrations with internal data sources.

As an AI Platform Engineer, you will be part of an ambitious and technically strong team that is responsible for developing and maintaining our WUR AI Facility. You play a key role in setting up and managing the necessary infrastructure in Azure, provisioning of the CI/CD pipeline, monitoring and improving performance and improving the user experience. The system management covers infrastructure, platform, applications and functional services.

We are looking for someone with a passion for IT, who has experience in building reliable infrastructure solutions based on Azure cloud solutions and on-premise cloud-native container environments.

Your tasks and responsibilities as an AI Platform Engineer are:

provisioning, managing, and further developing secure, reliable, and scalable Azure and Kubernetes environment(s) for the AI Facility;
provision and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes, including rollback and release procedures;
manage environments, infrastructure resources, technical configurations, and dependencies, while ensuring version control and consistent provisioning across all environments;
documenting technical architecture, management procedures and runbooks;
automate the use and management. Supporting releases and analyzing technical incidents, malfunctions and performance issues;
monitoring and improving platform performance, security, manageability and reliability. Setting up and maintaining the necessary monitoring, alerting and observability;
collaborate with software developers to improve the user experience;
you build it, you own it: you solve disruptions and performance issues together with your colleagues.

Your team

You will work in a team with a product owner, a scrum master, a solution architect, software developers and IT engineers. Our IT teams work according to agile principles. Collaboration, communication, transparency and continuous feedback are essential. You will work on campus at least two days a week and can choose to work partly from home as well, for good focus and a healthy work-life balance.

You will work here

You will work in a professional IT organization with more than 200 IT specialists where you can learn a lot and develop yourself well. We have two of our own data centers on our beautiful, green and spacious campus and we are committed to digital sovereignty, the use of open source solutions and a sustainable use of our environment. You will work with state-of-the-art technology in the field of Artificial Intelligence and the infrastructure used for this.

Your qualities

You are an independent and inquisitive IT professional with a DevOps mindset. You like to work together with other professionals and different stakeholders in an agile environment. You are a connector and dare to speak out and ask questions. You are a real go-getter, have strong communication skills and have a warm heart for education and research. In addition, you are analytically minded but also solution- and customer-oriented. You are enterprising and have the drive and organizational talent to get things done as a driving force. You are creative and always look for new solutions to make existing environments more effective and new functionalities possible. You also have a good eye for the availability, stability, scalability and user-friendliness of the infrastructure provided.

You Also Possess

HBO working and thinking level, preferably through a completed HBO ICT education;
experience as a System Administrator or DevOps Engineer in an enterprise environment;
knowledge of and experience with Linux and Kubernetes environments and Azure cloud solutions;
knowledge of designing and managing cloud-native concepts;
experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Terraform, Ansible) and a declarative mindset;
experience with containerization and CI/CD tools (e.g. ArgoCD, Git(lab));
basic knowledge of programming and scripting languages such as Python or Bash;
a good command of Dutch and English. The working language within the IT organization is Dutch, but in our international working environment, more and more communication is in English.

You can see that there are plenty of challenges for you. These challenges can also be seen as development opportunities. So if you do not yet have the track record required in the vacancy, but do have solid work experience, we would also like to invite you to apply.

We offer

Wageningen University & Research offers excellent terms of employment (https://www.wur.nl/en/jobs/conditions-of-employment). A few highlights from our Collective Labour Agreement include:

working hours that can be discussed and arranged so that they allow for the best possible work-life balance;
sabbatical leave, study leave, and partially paid parental leave;
there is a strong focus on vitality and you can make use of the sports facilities available on campus for a small fee;
a fixed year-end bonus of 8,3%;
excellent pension scheme.

Of course, these excellent fringe benefits also include an appropriate salary. Depending on your experience, we offer a salary of a minimum of € 3,554.- to a maximum of € 6,471.- for a full working week of 36 hours according to Collective Labor Agreement Wageningen Research (scale 10/11). For this role, an appointment of 32 hours is also negotiable. We initially offer a one-year contract, with the intention of converting it to an indefinite contract

We encourage development and internal mobility within our organisation. Our recruitment and selection policy sets out the conditions that apply specifically to you as a (former) employee. If you have any questions, we are happy to help.

You will work on the greenest and most innovative campus in the Netherlands, in an international and open working atmosphere.

If you are an internal employee, your current contract is the starting point. Ask your HR Business Partner about your situation specifically.

Coming from abroad

Wageningen University & Research is the university and research centre for life sciences. The themes we deal with are relevant to everyone around the world and Wageningen, therefore, has a large international community and a lot to offer to international employees.

Because we expect you to work and live in the Netherlands our team of advisors on Dutch immigration procedures will help you with the visa application procedures for yourself and, if applicable, for your family. If you come with a partner, we offer a Dual Career group program organized by our Welcome Center (https://wcfv.nl/en/home/global/our-services/happy-landing-and-living/). This program helps your partner to get familiar with the Dutch culture, labour market and assists your partner to find a job.

Feeling welcome also has everything to do with being well informed. Wageningen University & Research's International Community (https://www.wur.nl/en/jobs/expats-new-international-staff) page contains practical information about what we can do to support international employees coming to Wageningen. Furthermore, our Welcome Center can assist you with any additional advice and information about for example housing, opening a bank account or schooling. Finally, certain categories of international staff may be eligible for a tax exemption on a part of their salary during the first five years in the Netherlands.

Important information

For more information about the position, please contact Roy Bartels (Department Manager) via email: roy.bartels@wur.nl (mailto:roy.bartels@wur.nl).

jobs.description:
About Tripstack

Founded in Toronto, Canada in 2016, Tripstack has been part of Etraveli Group since 2019. It is a B2B Flights as a Service provider and a world leader in virtual interlining.

Operating from offices in Canada, India, and Poland, Tripstack is the gateway into Etraveli Group’s world leading tech platform - giving partners access to global flight content, virtual interlining, and a full suite of services including payments, fraud prevention, pricing, and customer support. As a world leader in virtual interlining technology, Tripstack connects non-partner, low-cost and full-service carriers, enabling the creation of unique and flexible itineraries through a simple, cost-effective API.

Its technology ingest over 30B price points and handles over 240 million searches daily.

Through partnerships with airlines, OTAs, and other distribution channels across the globe, Tripstack expands networks, drives new revenue streams, and offers more choice at competitive prices, all backed by robust technology and traveler protection.

For more information, visit:

www.tripstack.com

www.etraveligroup.com

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Booking Engine organization. You will own the technical direction of systems at the core of our product - pricing, availability and booking flows that serve millions of requests per day. Beyond writing code, you will set architectural direction, unblock others, and represent the team's technical position to product and to peer engineering groups.

This role suits someone who is a natural problem solver, detail-oriented, and comfortable moving between deep individual contribution and technical leadership in a fast-paced environment.

This is a senior individual contributor role with technical leadership scope. We do not have a separate formal tech lead title.

Responsibilities

Set and drive the technical direction for one or more Booking Engine services - make architecture decisions, document the trade-offs, and act as the technical point of contact in planning, prioritization and dependency discussions
Design, write, review, test and support C#/.NET code for reliable, high-quality systems at scale serving millions of requests per day
Break large initiatives into deliverable increments - design solutions, get them reviewed, create stories, deliver and maintain
Own latency, availability and cost characteristics of your services, and keep them within the reliability targets the organization sets
Maintain and evolve our gRPC-based API 2.0 alongside the .NET services it fronts, keeping the two in step as the API surface changes
Proactively identify technology opportunities for the company, and push technical ideas, proposals and plans to the entire organization
Work cross-functionally with product managers, client integration teams and other engineering groups to deliver high-quality products and improve internal KPIs
Coordinate and monitor regular releases to production
Participate in the on-call support rotation, lead the team through incidents impacting live systems, and drive follow-up actions to completion
Raise the engineering bar, mentor engineers through interactive code review, design review and knowledge-sharing sessions, and help the team make good use of AI-assisted development tooling

Requirements

Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or related technical field experience
7+ years of professional software engineering experience with C# and .NET, including production work on .NET Core / .NET 8+
Strong command of the .NET runtime under load, including performance trade-offs, caching, profiling and benchmarking
Strong software design and architecture skills - CS fundamentals, object-oriented analysis and design patterns, and large-scale distributed systems
Hands-on experience with Claude Code or equivalent AI coding assistants in production work, with sound judgement about when to rely on them and how to review what they produce
Proven track record of designing and architecting scalable, high-availability distributed systems serving internet traffic direct to consumers or businesses at scale
Demonstrated technical leadership, having led the design and delivery of a significant system across multiple engineers and grown the engineers around you
Experience owning production services on call, including leading incident response
Ability to clearly and concisely communicate with technical and non-technical stakeholders across all levels of the organization

Additional Experience That Would Be Considered An Asset

Experience designing and publishing client SDKs or public-facing APIs consumed by external partners
Experience with hybrid Google Cloud Platform or other cloud providers and cloud-native architecture alongside local data centre deployments
Experience with Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD tooling
Experience with monitoring dashboards (Grafana), alerting, logging, and PCI-related work
Experience with gRPC and protobuf-based service contracts

jobs.title: AI Platform engineer
jobs.description:
Career at WUR

About Us

Plenty of variety and challenges
Pleasant working atmosphere
Time for personal development
Proper work-life balance
Internationally leading

Your job

Within WUR, we are setting up our own chatAI environment in which our users (students, teachers, researchers) can use the possibilities of Artificial Intelligence for research and education safely and within established guardrails. This includes the WUR AI Chat, the WUR LLM Hub and integrations with internal data sources.

As an AI Platform Engineer, you will be part of an ambitious and technically strong team that is responsible for developing and maintaining our WUR AI Facility. You play a key role in setting up and managing the necessary infrastructure in Azure, provisioning of the CI/CD pipeline, monitoring and improving performance and improving the user experience. The system management covers infrastructure, platform, applications and functional services.

We are looking for someone with a passion for IT, who has experience in building reliable infrastructure solutions based on Azure cloud solutions and on-premise cloud-native container environments.

Your tasks and responsibilities as an AI Platform Engineer are:

provisioning, managing, and further developing secure, reliable, and scalable Azure and Kubernetes environment(s) for the AI Facility;
provision and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes, including rollback and release procedures;
manage environments, infrastructure resources, technical configurations, and dependencies, while ensuring version control and consistent provisioning across all environments;
documenting technical architecture, management procedures and runbooks;
automate the use and management. Supporting releases and analyzing technical incidents, malfunctions and performance issues;
monitoring and improving platform performance, security, manageability and reliability. Setting up and maintaining the necessary monitoring, alerting and observability;
collaborate with software developers to improve the user experience;
you build it, you own it: you solve disruptions and performance issues together with your colleagues.

Your team

You will work in a team with a product owner, a scrum master, a solution architect, software developers and IT engineers. Our IT teams work according to agile principles. Collaboration, communication, transparency and continuous feedback are essential. You will work on campus at least two days a week and can choose to work partly from home as well, for good focus and a healthy work-life balance.

You will work here

You will work in a professional IT organization with more than 200 IT specialists where you can learn a lot and develop yourself well. We have two of our own data centers on our beautiful, green and spacious campus and we are committed to digital sovereignty, the use of open source solutions and a sustainable use of our environment. You will work with state-of-the-art technology in the field of Artificial Intelligence and the infrastructure used for this.

Your qualities

You are an independent and inquisitive IT professional with a DevOps mindset. You like to work together with other professionals and different stakeholders in an agile environment. You are a connector and dare to speak out and ask questions. You are a real go-getter, have strong communication skills and have a warm heart for education and research. In addition, you are analytically minded but also solution- and customer-oriented. You are enterprising and have the drive and organizational talent to get things done as a driving force. You are creative and always look for new solutions to make existing environments more effective and new functionalities possible. You also have a good eye for the availability, stability, scalability and user-friendliness of the infrastructure provided.

You Also Possess

HBO working and thinking level, preferably through a completed HBO ICT education;
experience as a System Administrator or DevOps Engineer in an enterprise environment;
knowledge of and experience with Linux and Kubernetes environments and Azure cloud solutions;
knowledge of designing and managing cloud-native concepts;
experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Terraform, Ansible) and a declarative mindset;
experience with containerization and CI/CD tools (e.g. ArgoCD, Git(lab));
basic knowledge of programming and scripting languages such as Python or Bash;
a good command of Dutch and English. The working language within the IT organization is Dutch, but in our international working environment, more and more communication is in English.

You can see that there are plenty of challenges for you. These challenges can also be seen as development opportunities. So if you do not yet have the track record required in the vacancy, but do have solid work experience, we would also like to invite you to apply.

We offer

Wageningen University & Research offers excellent terms of employment . A few highlights from our Collective Labour Agreement include:

working hours that can be discussed and arranged so that they allow for the best possible work-life balance;
sabbatical leave, study leave, and partially paid parental leave;
there is a strong focus on vitality and you can make use of the sports facilities available on campus for a small fee;
a fixed year-end bonus of 8,3%;
excellent pension scheme.

Of course, these excellent fringe benefits also include an appropriate salary. Depending on your experience, we offer a salary of a minimum of € 3,554.- to a maximum of € 6,471.- for a full working week of 36 hours according to Collective Labor Agreement Wageningen Research (scale 10/11). For this role, an appointment of 32 hours is also negotiable. We initially offer a one-year contract, with the intention of converting it to an indefinite contract

We encourage development and internal mobility within our organisation. Our recruitment and selection policy sets out the conditions that apply specifically to you as a (former) employee. If you have any questions, we are happy to help.

You will work on the greenest and most innovative campus in the Netherlands, in an international and open working atmosphere.

If you are an internal employee, your current contract is the starting point. Ask your HR Business Partner about your situation specifically.

Coming from abroad

Wageningen University & Research is the university and research centre for life sciences. The themes we deal with are relevant to everyone around the world and Wageningen, therefore, has a large international community and a lot to offer to international employees.

Because we expect you to work and live in the Netherlands our team of advisors on Dutch immigration procedures will help you with the visa application procedures for yourself and, if applicable, for your family. If you come with a partner, we offer a Dual Career group program organized by our Welcome Center . This program helps your partner to get familiar with the Dutch culture, labour market and assists your partner to find a job.

Feeling welcome also has everything to do with being well informed. Wageningen University & Research's International Community page contains practical information about what we can do to support international employees coming to Wageningen. Furthermore, our Welcome Center can assist you with any additional advice and information about for example housing, opening a bank account or schooling. Finally, certain categories of international staff may be eligible for a tax exemption on a part of their salary during the first five years in the Netherlands.

Important information

For more information about the position, please contact Roy Bartels (Department Manager) via email: roy.bartels@wur.nl.

Questions about the procedure? Please contact Edvard Jongschaap, Sr Corporate Recruiter, via email: edvard.jongschaap@wur.nl or by phone: +31 371 – 489 178.

Ready to apply?

Click on the application button for the vacancy on our website. Only applications via our website will be processed.

You can respond until Monday, November 2, 2026
. The first interviews are scheduled for Thursday, November 5, 2026. Preferably, internal candidates apply before October 2, 2026.

Applications are reviewed regularly. It is therefore possible that the vacancy has been filled earlier than the stated closing date.

Screening policy

Procedure

Welcome, safe, and valued

Wageningen University & Research (WUR) highly values diversity and inclusion because we believe that different insights lead to innovative solutions. We create a work environment where everyone feels welcome, safe, and appreciated, regardless of background, identity, or experience. Together, we are building a culture where everyone's unique contribution adds to the success of our organization.

We are

The mission of Wageningen University & Research is “To explore the potential of nature to improve the quality of life”. Under the banner Wageningen University & Research, Wageningen University and the specialised research institutes of the Wageningen Research Foundation have joined forces in contributing to finding solutions to important questions in the domain of healthy food and living environment. With its roughly 30 branches, 7,600 employees (6,700 fte) and 13,100 students and over 150,000 participants to WUR’s Life Long Learning, Wageningen University & Research is one of the leading organisations in its domain. new_jobs.title: test automation engineer forensische opsporing
new_jobs.description:
Binnen de afdeling Forensische Opsporing ontwikkelen we een applicatie waarbij de forensisch onderzoeker de sporen kan vastleggen bij bijv. een woninginbraak, plofkraak of moord. Wil jij als Test Automation Engineer een belangrijke en nuttige bijdrage leveren? Maak dan je CSI-droom waar bij ons!

Wat ga je doen?

Je gaat aan de slag in één van de drie ontwikkelteams binnen het Programma Vernieuwend Registreren - Cluster Forensische Opsporing (FO). In dit team word jij dé tester en werk je nauw samen met de ontwikkelaars en informatieanalist uit je eigen team. Daarnaast zoek je de samenwerking op met de test automation engineers van andere ontwikkelteams, zowel binnen als buiten FO.

Jouw rol is het verder uitbreiden en professionaliseren van testautomatisering waarbij we gebruik maken van TestCafé (in de nabije toekomst Playwright) voor de front-end integratie- en end-to-end-testen.

Verder ga je aan de slag met

Uitvoeren en reviewen van functionele (handmatige en geautomatiseerde) testen;
Uitvoeren en ondersteunen van keten- en gebruikersacceptatietesten;
Opzetten, uitbreiden en onderhouden van testautomatisering;
Bijdragen aan de innovatie van testautomatisering en verbeteringen bepalen en doorvoeren;
Opstellen en vastleggen van testscenario’s en testcases;
Actief aandragen van structurele verbetervoorstellen;
Actief bijdragen aan refinements, Three Amigos sessies en de Community of Practice Test;
Actief kennis delen binnen en buiten je team over teststrategieën en testautomatisering;
Vraagbaak voor collega’s binnen het team;
Samenwerking met ontwikkelaars in het testproces;
Afhankelijk van de workload waar nodig ook ontwikkel- en/of beheerwerkzaamheden oppakken;
Representeren van het team en het testwerk naar buiten toe, zoals presenteren aan stakeholders.

Waar ga je werken?

Je gaat aan de slag binnen het Productiehuis waar we cruciale softwareoplossingen ontwikkelen en onderhouden die het politiewerk dagelijks ondersteunen. Je maakt deel uit van de Productielijn Handhaving, Cluster Forensische Opsporing waar je in een multidisciplinair team werkt aan het ontwikkelen van nieuwe functionaliteiten voor operationele politiediensten.

We werken Agile en hybride, dat betekent dat je twee dagen per week fysiek op locatie in Utrecht te vinden bent en daarnaast thuis kunt werken. De overall sfeer in de FO-teams is open, informeel en we delen onze passie voor het vakgebied.

Je komt te werken in een bevlogen team en daar zoeken wij een enthousiaste collega bij. Iemand die graag investeert in het leren kennen van zijn/haar collega’s, positieve energie meebrengt en trots is op zijn/haar werk voor de Forensische Opsporing bij de politie.

Daarnaast voel jij je niet alleen verantwoordelijkheid voor de kwaliteit van je eigen testwerk, maar draag je ook actief bij aan de kwaliteit van testen en de testprocessen binnen de Forensische Opsporing.

Wie ben jij?

Wij zoeken eigenlijk gewoon een hele leuke en ervaren tester
in ons nieuw op te bouwen team. Ben jij dat en heb je verder

hbo (bachelor) werk- en denkniveau en een opleiding bij voorkeur in de richting van ICT of soortgelijk;*
minimaal een certificaat van ISTQB, TMAP of CAT;
aantoonbare ervaring met gestandaardiseerde testtools, zoals TestCafé, Cypress en/of Playwright;
minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring met geautomatiseerd testen en handmatig testen;
bij voorkeur ervaring met Agile werken.

In verband met het begrijpen van, en navigeren door, het werk van de ontwikkelaars en testers, is het ook een pre als je iets van ervaring hebt met

Java en/of TypeScript
Git
Jenkins
Angular

Wat wij bieden

De formele standplaats is Utrecht. Er is ruimte voor 1 fte. Het betreft een functie voor 36 uur per week (36 uur is standaard een fulltime werkweek bij de politie).

Omdat goede mensen belangrijk zijn binnen de politie investeren we in jouw toekomst. We bieden uitgebreide ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en een aanstelling in tijdelijke dienst voor een proeftijd van een jaar. Bij voldoende functioneren zetten we na een jaar de aanstelling o m in een vaste aanstelling.

een bruto maandsalaris van minimaal € 3.734,- en maximaal € 5.882,- (schaal 10 Bbp) op basis van een 36-urige werkweek;

new_jobs.title: AI Platform engineer
new_jobs.description:
Your job

Within WUR, we are setting up our own chatAI environment in which our users (students, teachers, researchers) can use the possibilities of Artificial Intelligence for research and education safely and within established guardrails. This includes the WUR AI Chat, the WUR LLM Hub and integrations with internal data sources.

As an AI Platform Engineer, you will be part of an ambitious and technically strong team that is responsible for developing and maintaining our WUR AI Facility. You play a key role in setting up and managing the necessary infrastructure in Azure, provisioning of the CI/CD pipeline, monitoring and improving performance and improving the user experience. The system management covers infrastructure, platform, applications and functional services.

We are looking for someone with a passion for IT, who has experience in building reliable infrastructure solutions based on Azure cloud solutions and on-premise cloud-native container environments.

Your tasks and responsibilities as an AI Platform Engineer are:

provisioning, managing, and further developing secure, reliable, and scalable Azure and Kubernetes environment(s) for the AI Facility;
provision and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes, including rollback and release procedures;
manage environments, infrastructure resources, technical configurations, and dependencies, while ensuring version control and consistent provisioning across all environments;
documenting technical architecture, management procedures and runbooks;
automate the use and management. Supporting releases and analyzing technical incidents, malfunctions and performance issues;
monitoring and improving platform performance, security, manageability and reliability. Setting up and maintaining the necessary monitoring, alerting and observability;
collaborate with software developers to improve the user experience;
you build it, you own it: you solve disruptions and performance issues together with your colleagues.

Your team

You will work in a team with a product owner, a scrum master, a solution architect, software developers and IT engineers. Our IT teams work according to agile principles. Collaboration, communication, transparency and continuous feedback are essential. You will work on campus at least two days a week and can choose to work partly from home as well, for good focus and a healthy work-life balance.

You will work here

You will work in a professional IT organization with more than 200 IT specialists where you can learn a lot and develop yourself well. We have two of our own data centers on our beautiful, green and spacious campus and we are committed to digital sovereignty, the use of open source solutions and a sustainable use of our environment. You will work with state-of-the-art technology in the field of Artificial Intelligence and the infrastructure used for this.

Your qualities

You are an independent and inquisitive IT professional with a DevOps mindset. You like to work together with other professionals and different stakeholders in an agile environment. You are a connector and dare to speak out and ask questions. You are a real go-getter, have strong communication skills and have a warm heart for education and research. In addition, you are analytically minded but also solution- and customer-oriented. You are enterprising and have the drive and organizational talent to get things done as a driving force. You are creative and always look for new solutions to make existing environments more effective and new functionalities possible. You also have a good eye for the availability, stability, scalability and user-friendliness of the infrastructure provided.

You Also Possess

HBO working and thinking level, preferably through a completed HBO ICT education;
experience as a System Administrator or DevOps Engineer in an enterprise environment;
knowledge of and experience with Linux and Kubernetes environments and Azure cloud solutions;
knowledge of designing and managing cloud-native concepts;
experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Terraform, Ansible) and a declarative mindset;
experience with containerization and CI/CD tools (e.g. ArgoCD, Git(lab));
basic knowledge of programming and scripting languages such as Python or Bash;
a good command of Dutch and English. The working language within the IT organization is Dutch, but in our international working environment, more and more communication is in English.

You can see that there are plenty of challenges for you. These challenges can also be seen as development opportunities. So if you do not yet have the track record required in the vacancy, but do have solid work experience, we would also like to invite you to apply.

We offer

Wageningen University & Research offers excellent terms of employment (https://www.wur.nl/en/jobs/conditions-of-employment). A few highlights from our Collective Labour Agreement include:

working hours that can be discussed and arranged so that they allow for the best possible work-life balance;
sabbatical leave, study leave, and partially paid parental leave;
there is a strong focus on vitality and you can make use of the sports facilities available on campus for a small fee;
a fixed year-end bonus of 8,3%;
excellent pension scheme.

Of course, these excellent fringe benefits also include an appropriate salary. Depending on your experience, we offer a salary of a minimum of € 3,554.- to a maximum of € 6,471.- for a full working week of 36 hours according to Collective Labor Agreement Wageningen Research (scale 10/11). For this role, an appointment of 32 hours is also negotiable. We initially offer a one-year contract, with the intention of converting it to an indefinite contract

We encourage development and internal mobility within our organisation. Our recruitment and selection policy sets out the conditions that apply specifically to you as a (former) employee. If you have any questions, we are happy to help.

You will work on the greenest and most innovative campus in the Netherlands, in an international and open working atmosphere.

If you are an internal employee, your current contract is the starting point. Ask your HR Business Partner about your situation specifically.

Coming from abroad

Wageningen University & Research is the university and research centre for life sciences. The themes we deal with are relevant to everyone around the world and Wageningen, therefore, has a large international community and a lot to offer to international employees.

Because we expect you to work and live in the Netherlands our team of advisors on Dutch immigration procedures will help you with the visa application procedures for yourself and, if applicable, for your family. If you come with a partner, we offer a Dual Career group program organized by our Welcome Center (https://wcfv.nl/en/home/global/our-services/happy-landing-and-living/). This program helps your partner to get familiar with the Dutch culture, labour market and assists your partner to find a job.

Feeling welcome also has everything to do with being well informed. Wageningen University & Research's International Community (https://www.wur.nl/en/jobs/expats-new-international-staff) page contains practical information about what we can do to support international employees coming to Wageningen. Furthermore, our Welcome Center can assist you with any additional advice and information about for example housing, opening a bank account or schooling. Finally, certain categories of international staff may be eligible for a tax exemption on a part of their salary during the first five years in the Netherlands.

Important information

For more information about the position, please contact Roy Bartels (Department Manager) via email: roy.bartels@wur.nl (mailto:roy.bartels@wur.nl).

Questions about the procedure? Please contact Edvard Jongschaap, Sr Corporate Recruiter, via email: edvard.jongschaap@wur.nl (mailto:edvard.jongschaap@wur.nl) or by phone: +31 371 – 489 178.

Ready to apply?

Click on the application button for the vacancy on our website. Only applications via our website will be processed.

You can respond until Monday, November 2, 2026
. The first interviews are scheduled for Thursday, November 5, 2026. Preferably, internal candidates apply before October 2, 2026.

Applications are reviewed regularly. It is therefore possible that the vacancy has been filled earlier than the stated closing date.

Screening policy
.

Submitting a valid Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG) and requesting references are part of the application procedure.

Procedure

Within our selection procedure, an assessment of working and thinking level can be included as part of the process.

Welcome, safe, and valued

Wageningen University & Research (WUR) highly values diversity and inclusion because we believe that different insights lead to innovative solutions. We create a work environment where everyone feels welcome, safe, and appreciated, regardless of background, identity, or experience. Together, we are building a culture where everyone's unique contribution adds to the success of our organization.

We are

The mission of Wageningen University & Research is “To explore the potential of nature to improve the quality of life”. Under the banner Wageningen University & Research, Wageningen University and the specialised research institutes of the Wageningen Research Foundation have joined forces in contributing to finding solutions to important questions in the domain of healthy food and living environment. With its roughly 30 branches, 7,600 employees (6,700 fte) and 13,100 students and over 150,000 participants to WUR’s Life Long Learning, Wageningen University & Research is one of the leading organisations in its domain. The unique Wageningen approach lies in its integrated approach to issues and the collaboration between different disciplines.

You play a key role in setting up and managing the necessary infrastructure in Azure, provisioning of the CI/CD pipeline, monitoring and improving performance and improving the user experience. The system management covers infrastructure, platform, applications and functional services.

We are looking for someone with a passion for IT, who has experience in building reliable infrastructure solutions based on Azure cloud solutions and on-premise cloud-native container environments.

Your tasks and responsibilities as an AI Platform Engineer are:

provisioning, managing, and further developing secure, reliable, and scalable Azure and Kubernetes environment(s) for the AI Facility;
provision and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes, including rollback and release procedures;
manage environments, infrastructure resources, technical configurations, and dependencies, while ensuring version control and consistent provisioning across all environments;
documenting technical architecture, management procedures and runbooks;
automate the use and management. Supporting releases and analyzing technical incidents, malfunctions and performance issues;
monitoring and improving platform performance, security, manageability and reliability. Setting up and maintaining the necessary monitoring, alerting and observability;
collaborate with software developers to improve the user experience;
you build it, you own it: you solve disruptions and performance issues together with your colleagues.

You will work in a team with a product owner, a scrum master, a solution architect, software developers and IT engineers. Our IT teams work according to agile principles. You are an independent and inquisitive IT professional with a DevOps mindset. You like to work together with other professionals and different stakeholders in an agile environment. working hours that can be discussed and arranged so that they allow for the best possible work-life balance;

there is a strong focus on vitality and you can make use of the sports facilities available on campus for a small fee;
a fixed year-end bonus of 8,3%;
excellent pension scheme.

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Customer Capabilities Tribe’s mission is to deliver "end-to-end" customer-centric pricing, reporting and document-lifecycle solutions. We make sure this happens by empowering Business with self-service tools that accelerate the delivery of innovative products and services to market.

Our team is cross-functional and you will be working closely with IT Architects, BI Engineers, DevOps specialists, IT Systems and Business analysts to deliver modern solutions, using advanced technologies. We are inspired by a commitment to improvement, so you can expect to work in an environment that values collaboration and knowledge sharing.

We are currently looking for two Full Stack Engineers to join the Corporate Pricing Squad, where you will help calculate and manage profit margins for corporate customers, supporting transparent, data-driven pricing across the bank.

If you are passionate about backend .NET engineering, business logic and building reliable systems that support important financial decisions and processes, we want to hear from you.

You will:

Develop software that is trusted, testable, easily maintainable and reliable
Closely collaborate with business users, developers, IT architects and different teams within the bank
Seek continuous learning and improvement for yourself and your team
Contribute ideas that improve our engineering practices, ways of working and solution design.
Work with technologies such as .NET for custom solutions, React, MS SQL, AWS, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Terraform, and CI/CD to deliver high-quality solutions

About you:

Core engineering experience: 3+ years of full-stack development experience for distributed enterprise systems, with solid backend .NET experience, strong C# skills and experience developing maintainable services.
API and service development: Experience designing, developing and maintaining REST APIs that support robust, efficient and secure interactions between services and downstream consumers.
Cloud and DevOps: Experience building and operating backend services in a modern cloud environment, including AWS Public Cloud native services such as Lambda, S3 and DynamoDB.
Automation and infrastructure: Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and infrastructure as code using Terraform, with a commitment to deploying changes safely and frequently.
Quality and security mindset: Ability to write effective unit tests and contribute to high-quality code through automated testing and good engineering practices, while working in a regulated environment where security, compliance, auditability and data protection matter.
Problem solving and collaboration: Excellent problem-solving skills, the ability to think algorithmically, and effective communication and teamwork skills.
Language skills: Upper-intermediate English, both written and verbal.

"We celebrate multiple approaches and points of view. We believe diversity drives innovation."

We offer:

Monthly salary range from 3680 EUR to 5520 EUR gross (based on your competencies relevant for the job).

Additionally, each Danske Bank employee receives employee benefits package which includes:

Growth opportunities: professional & supportive team, e-learnings, numerous development programs; (incl. professional certificates); 100+ professions for internal mobility opportunities.
Health & Well-being: a diverse, inclusive, work & life balance work environment; additional health insurance; mental well-being practices; partial psychologist counselling compensation; silence and sleep zones at the office; game rooms.
Hybrid working conditions: Work from home up to two days a week; home office budget after the probation period; modern Danske Campus workplace developed with input from anthropologists to support a strong employee experience.
Additional days of leave: for rest, health, volunteering, exams in higher education institutions, and other important activities. Moreover, for seniority with Danske Bank.
Monetary compensation package: accidents and critical diseases insurance; financial support in case of unfortunate events; travel insurance; 3rd Pillar Pension Fund contribution.

See all the benefits HERE.

Your job function (position) in the job contract will be Software Engineering.

If you would like to learn more about the role, you are welcome to contact Nicolaj Selsted via LinkedIn.

About Us

Danske Bank is a Nordic bank with bridges to the world around us. For 150 years, we have supported people and businesses in releasing their potential. A career with us is an opportunity to join a community of 22,000 colleagues in a culture where we are committed to Teaming Up, Owning It and Being Open. Together, we are on a journey to transform Danske Bank into a better bank. For our customers, our employees and the societies around us.
